{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds a new Cap'n Proto interface definition (events.capnp) and implementation (interfaces/events.h, ipc/capnp/events-types.h) for an IPC Events service.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds an Events IPC interface streaming block and mempool notifications, directly addressing external integration needs that ZMQ cannot satisfy. 'External clients can subscribe to block connections, disconnections, and mempool additions or removals, with optional serialized payloads, fees, vsize, and sequence numbers' to fix long-standing gaps noted in #19462 and #23624."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/kernel/mempool_entry.h only to add a field for mempool sequence tracking; does not alter kernel API or boundaries.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Incidental edit to mempool_entry.h to propagate consumed mempool sequence numbers; not an API change or decoupling effort for libbitcoinkernel."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes txmempool.cpp and txmempool.h to record consumed mempool sequences when transactions are removed during block inclusion.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Modifies internal mempool tracking to record consumed mempool sequence numbers on block-induced transaction removals. While necessary for downstream ordering, it does not alter mempool acceptance, policy, or eviction rules."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only minor mechanical diff in src/ipc/capnp/mining.capnp (+2/-3) without touching block template construction or mining logic.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mining interface changes are incidental capnp adjustments, not changes to template generation or Stratum v2 provider semantics."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "New functional test interface_ipc_events.py tests the feature itself; 1-line diffs to test runner and framework are incidental test wiring.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Test changes accompany the new IPC events feature rather than improving general test infrastructure or runner capabilities."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Diffs in init.cpp and init executables are standard wiring to initialize the IPC service.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Wiring changes in initialization files follow mechanically from adding the new IPC interface."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 1,
    "user_value": 2,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
